question: In a code language, 'VEIN' is coded as XGKP and 'BONE' is coded as DQPG. How will 'CHIN' be coded in the same language?
solution:
The alphabets and their positions are:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a2074f2af1444ff647bcff61bf4a768c4f4d9fb9ab69389563894deb3580edad.png] 

The logic here is:

For the word 'VEIN' is coded as XGKP and 'BONE' is coded as DQPG

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2b301832fe642e641701d2cf165b5c8c9b2a9fa8e612cb1219ceb4bf4d4b87b6.png] AND [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1b2a8ede18ee916c71072533e50c63cfba57f99bbe3247fe0d180bb56a1cad94.png] 

Similarly, for the word CHIN, we have:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/080dbd180b7f1a1f41262e88de6bf445c8524285b9fbf47f0e06623b73182b93.png] 

Thus, the next letter cluster is EJKP.

Hence, the correct answer is '__option 1__'.
